resources.string: Scan the QR on the build screen, or type the code printed under it.
Type a pack code first — it is shown under the QR on the build screen.
Nothing loaded yet. Enter a pack code and pull it down.
Phone linked — share clips to StickerForge to stage them
This phone isn\'t linked. On StickerForge, tap Link phone and scan the QR.
%1$d animated stickers ready. Add them to WhatsApp below.
Load cancelled. Nothing was changed on this device.
Can\'t reach %1$s. Make sure this device is on the same private network as your StickerForge host and that the server is running.
%1$s took too long to answer. Check the host is still up, then try again.
No built pack called %1$s on this host. Build it in StickerForge first, or re-check the code.
The StickerForge server answered with %1$s. Try again, or rebuild the pack.
The manifest this host returned isn\'t a pack the importer can read. Rebuild the pack in StickerForge.
WhatsApp needs at least 3 stickers — this pack has %1$d. Add more and rebuild.
Couldn\'t save the pack on this device. Check there is free space, then try again.
One or more files came back incomplete. Try again.
Something went wrong while loading. Try again.
On this Android version thumbnails show their first frame. WhatsApp plays the full animation either way.
The pack is on this device — one tap sends it to WhatsApp.
Load a pack to unlock this.
Hold on — the pack is still coming down.
The last load failed. Fix it above, then this unlocks.
WhatsApp isn\'t installed on this device.
Pack added. Open any chat → sticker tray to use it.
WhatsApp didn\'t confirm the pack. It usually means this app isn\'t whitelisted yet.
Closed without adding. The pack stays ready — tap again anytime.
No WhatsApp install found on this device.
